[P2] Return to the required design review

CONTRIBUTING rules 2 and 3 require a design note comparing alternatives, including simplifying existing logic. This introduces automatic stack cleanup and a `--dry-run` option, but the description still contains no alternatives comparison or linked design note. Following rule 9, return to the design phase described in rule 8.6, document the alternatives and chosen stack lifecycle, and obtain maintainer agreement before proceeding.
